name: searchSpotify
description: Search for tracks, albums, artists, playlists, podcast episodes, or shows on Spotify. For episodes and shows, the query matches against title, description, and publisher. Use type "episode" to find individual podcast episodes by topic or guest name, and type "show" to find podcast series.

query.description: The search query. Matches title, description, and publisher for podcasts.

type.description: The type of item to search for: track, album, artist, playlist, episode (podcast episode), or show (podcast series)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 10)

offset.description: Index of the first result to return (default: 0). Combine with limit to page past the first 10 results.

name: getNowPlaying
description: Get information about the currently playing track on Spotify, including device and volume info

name: getMyPlaylists
description: Get a list of the current user's playlists on Spotify

limit.description: Maximum number of playlists to return (1-50)

name: getPlaylistTracks
description: Get a list of tracks in a Spotify playlist

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (1-50)

name: getRecentlyPlayed
description: Get a list of recently played tracks on Spotify

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (1-50)

name: getUsersSavedTracks
description: Get a list of tracks saved in the user's "Liked Songs" library

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (1-50)

name: removeUsersSavedTracks
description: Remove one or more tracks from the user's "Liked Songs" library (max 40 per request)

trackIds.description: Array of Spotify track IDs to remove (max 40)

name: getQueue
description: Get a list of the currently playing track and the next items in your Spotify queue

limit.description: Maximum number of upcoming items to show (1-50)

name: getAvailableDevices
description: Get information about the user's available Spotify Connect devices

name: getTopTracks
description: Get the current user's top (most-played) tracks over a given time range. This is the closest thing Spotify exposes to listening statistics.

timeRange.description: Time range: short_term (~4 weeks), medium_term (~6 months), or long_term (~1 year). Default: medium_term.

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (1-50)

name: getTopArtists
description: Get the current user's top (most-played) artists over a given time range. This is the closest thing Spotify exposes to listening statistics.

timeRange.description: Time range: short_term (~4 weeks), medium_term (~6 months), or long_term (~1 year). Default: medium_term.

limit.description: Maximum number of artists to return (1-50)

name: playMusic
description: Start playing a Spotify track, album, artist, or playlist. Pass a Spotify URI (e.g. spotify:track:xxx, spotify:album:xxx) via "uri". For albums/playlists you can also use "context_uri". Device is selected automatically — "deviceId" or "device_id" are optional.

uri.description: Spotify URI to play (e.g. spotify:track:xxx, spotify:album:xxx)

context_uri.description: Alias for uri — Spotify context URI for albums/playlists

type.description: Type of item (only needed with id)

id.description: Spotify ID of the item (use with type)

deviceId.description: Spotify device ID to play on (auto-selected if omitted)

name: pausePlayback
description: Pause Spotify playback on the active device

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to pause playback on

name: skipToNext
description: Skip to the next track in the current Spotify playback queue

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to skip on

name: skipToPrevious
description: Skip to the previous track in the current Spotify playback queue

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to skip on

name: createPlaylist
description: Create a new playlist on Spotify

public.description: Whether the playlist should be public

name: addTracksToPlaylist
description: Add tracks or podcast episodes to a Spotify playlist. Accepts Spotify track IDs, episode IDs, or full Spotify URIs (e.g. spotify:episode:xxx).

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

trackIds.description: Array of Spotify IDs or URIs to add. Plain IDs are assumed to be tracks. To add podcast episodes, pass full URIs: spotify:episode:{id}.

position.description: Position to insert the items (0-based index)

name: resumePlayback
description: Resume Spotify playback on the active device

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to resume playback on

name: addToQueue
description: Adds a track, album, artist or playlist to the playback queue

uri.description: The Spotify URI to play (overrides type and id)

type.description: The type of item to play

id.description: The Spotify ID of the item to play

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to add the track to

name: setVolume
description: Set the playback volume to a specific percentage (0-100). Requires Spotify Premium.

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to set volume on

name: adjustVolume
description: Adjust the playback volume up or down by a relative amount. Use positive values to increase, negative to decrease. Requires Spotify Premium.

adjustment.description: The amount to adjust volume by (-100 to 100). Positive increases, negative decreases.

deviceId.description: The Spotify device ID to adjust volume on

name: getAlbums
description: Get detailed information about one or more albums by their Spotify IDs

albumIds.description: A single album ID or array of album IDs (max 20)

name: getAlbumTracks
description: Get tracks from a specific album with pagination support

albumId.description: The Spotify ID of the album

limit.description: Maximum number of tracks to return (1-50)

name: saveOrRemoveAlbumForUser
description: Save or remove albums from the user's "Your Music" library

action.description: Action to perform: save or remove albums

name: checkUsersSavedAlbums
description: Check if albums are saved in the user's "Your Music" library

albumIds.description: Array of Spotify album IDs to check (max 20)

name: getPlaylist
description: Get details of a specific Spotify playlist including tracks count, description and owner

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

name: updatePlaylist
description: Update the details of a Spotify playlist (name, description, public/private, collaborative)

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

public.description: Whether the playlist should be public

collaborative.description: Whether the playlist should be collaborative (requires public to be false)

name: removeTracksFromPlaylist
description: Remove one or more tracks from a Spotify playlist (max 100 tracks per request)

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

trackIds.description: Array of Spotify track IDs to remove (max 100)

snapshotId.description: The playlist snapshot ID to target a specific version (optional)

name: reorderPlaylistItems
description: Reorder a range of tracks within a Spotify playlist by moving them to a new position

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist

rangeStart.description: The position of the first item to move (0-based index)

insertBefore.description: The position where the items should be inserted (0-based index)

rangeLength.description: Number of consecutive items to move (defaults to 1)

snapshotId.description: The playlist snapshot ID to target a specific version (optional)

name: unfollowPlaylist
description: Remove a playlist from the current user's library (unfollow). Note: Spotify does not allow permanent deletion of playlists via the API.

playlistId.description: The Spotify ID of the playlist to unfollow
